style: carry on from the previous verse in one line

candidates.angle: prashantatma, what a peaceful inner state means
candidates.evidence: प्रशान्तात्मा (one whose inner state is peaceful)

candidates.angle: madhuparah, Krishna as the supreme aim of the yogi
candidates.evidence: मत्परः (for whom I am the supreme aim)

candidates.angle: The yogi sits devoted to Krishna after restraining the mind
candidates.evidence: मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः

en.intro: The previous verse fixed the body, and this one turns to the inner conditions of the mind before it can rest in peace.
en.notice: The word madhuparah, for whom I am the supreme aim, shows that the yogi's meditation is directed toward Krishna as the highest goal, and this devotion is the very purpose of his sitting.
en.next: Krishna now says that by keeping the mind united in this way, the yogi attains the supreme peace that comes from Him.
en.meaning: The yogi, with a peaceful mind, free of fear, and firm in celibate discipline, restrains the mind, fixes awareness on Me, and sits devoted to Me as the supreme aim.

hi.intro: पिछली श्लोक में शरीर स्थिर करने की बात थी, अब श्रीकृष्ण मन की भीतरी अवस्था बताते हैं ताकि वह शांति पा सके।
hi.meaning: जिसका अंतःकरण शांत है, जो भय से मुक्त है और जो ब्रह्मचर्य के व्रत में स्थित है, ऐसा साधक मन का संयम करे। वह अपना चित्त मुझमें लगाकर, मुझे ही परम लक्ष्य मानकर, सावधान होकर बैठे।
hi.notice: मत्परः, यानी जिसके लिए मैं ही सर्वोच्च लक्ष्य हूँ, इस बात से स्पष्ट होता है कि योगी का ध्यान भगवान की ओर केंद्रित है, और यही उसकी साधना का उद्देश्य है।
hi.next: कृष्ण अब कहते हैं कि इस प्रकार मन को एकाग्र रखने वाला योगी मुझमें स्थित परम शांति प्राप्त करता है।

The word madhuparah, for whom I am the supreme aim, shows that the yogi's meditation is directed toward Krishna as the highest goal, and this devotion is the very purpose of his sitting. Krishna now says that by keeping the mind united in this way, the yogi attains the supreme peace that comes from Him.
